newsitem.title: UK: United Assurance new premiums up 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: United Assurance new premiums up 1.9 pct.

text.p: United Assurance Plc on Thursday said new equivakent premium income rose 1.9 percent in 1996 to 66.3 million stg while sales of annual premiums were broadly unchanged and single premium business rose significantly.
Sales of new ordinary branch annual premiums were 33.1 million stg compared to 32.5 million in 1995.
United said the encouraging increase in single premium life and pensions business was also reflected in sales of unit trusts and PEPS, which were up 53.2 percent to 38 million stg.
United was formed last year by the merger of Refuge Assurance and United Friendly. -- London Newsroom +434 171 542 7717.
